design.design: same career/seed/opponent; automatic rotation/timeouts off; rotation pairs use six ordinary rolling-sub commands; style pairs change actual manager tactics only; roles uses uniform physical profiles with existing technical identity

notes: Paired complete matches; score is secondary. Ordinary sanction replacements remain legal even with automatic rotation disabled.
Observed fatigue-band conversion is selection/context dependent, not an empirical causal estimate. Difficulty >.35, clear pressure <.2 and range <7.5m are diagnostics only.
Role exposure comes from actual action channels; positional labels are never read by physicalLoad.ts. The optional roles trial holds all physical profiles equal.
Named failed receptions are one technical error channel, not the official source definition of all technical errors.
Load segments are one-second observations; whole canonical finalLoad retains exact work totals. Recovery movement speed depends on changing duty geometry.
